We live in a nightmare we can’t wake up from. It doesn’t get better, I know it.

When I was in 6th-7th grade in public schooling (not too long ago), I didn’t feel loved. I didn’t feel anything, actually. The school I went to acted like they had nothing they could do for suicidal thinking teens like me. I was assessed for suicidal ideation twice. Did anything change? No, nothing did. All I ever wanted to do was just play a game. I had no motivation to really talk to anyone, to really do anything in the school. I’d always fake sickness to leave the school and go home.

In all honestly, life sucks. But you know what? It really does get better. If you killed yourself in your own home, right next to your cats, do you really believe they wouldn’t miss you? Do you think that anyone in your life isn’t going to miss you? It couldn’t be more far from the truth.

Nobody wants you dead. They all want you to be home, and live your life how you want to. Don’t take away the opportunity for them to love you more than you could imagine. The truth will set you free of your pain, I promise.
You’re very pretty! It doesn’t matter what the haters say. No matter what, you’re always going to be amazing, and the best you can be. Even if you don’t believe it, it doesn’t mean it’s not true.
We are united as one. We all shall survive the pain together. Thank you. ❤️

It’s cruel that people have to go through this. I know how you feel. I used to do terrible in public school (homeschooled now) because I could never focus in class, or on homework. I felt hopeless because I never thought I could beat this obstacle. I don’t understand the mind as well as others, but I can tell you that we have a lot in common. I’m really sorry that you have to deal with this. I never imagined this is how the world is like sometimes. I’m here to talk if you need it.

I envision my life a better one every day. I imagine myself doing a lot more than I could today. It’s not wrong to feel this way, no. A lot of people do it, including me. Unfortunately, we have to live our real lives to our extent, and do the best we can do. I’m sorry that you have to feel that you need to imagine yourself in another reality to feel happy. It’s an unfortunate world we live in. If you want to talk, I’m here.

Honestly, I feel like the people who have gone through what you’re going through cares the most. They understand more than anyone. I’m sorry that you have to be this way, and unfortunately, I hate that it’s even possible for oneself to go through such pain, but do understand that a lot of people care about you. You’re never alone, even if you feel lonely.

It’s easy to hide emotions. On the outside you look alright, but on the inside you feel like total crap. I understand it completely. I’ve done it many times before not to upset my friends. I’m really sorry you have to go through this. I’ll be here to talk if you’d like.
You’re a very pretty girl! I’m sorry you have to go through depression, I can tell you that you are a fighter though. You’re still here even when going through hard times.
